question: Which of the following airports is being built as India’s first ‘carbon-neutral airport’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh airport**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Leh Airport is being built as India's first **carbon-neutral airport**. 
 
• The airport will use a geothermal system and solar PV plant to **heat and cool the terminal building.** 
 
• The system will concentrate naturally existing heat and use it for space heating, cooling, and water heating.
